description:
Expose get_tree/1 and set_label/3 through the GenServer stack so the TUI can call them.

## SessionStore (apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_store.ex)

### get_tree/1
```elixir
@spec get_tree(pid()) :: [OctoPi.Coder.Session.TreeNode.t()]
def get_tree(pid), do: GenServer.call(pid, :get_tree)
```
Handler: {:get_tree} → {:reply, SessionManager.get_tree(sm), state}

### append_label_change/3
```elixir
@spec append_label_change(pid(), String.t(), String.t() | nil) :: :ok
def append_label_change(pid, target_id, label),
  do: GenServer.call(pid, {:append_label_change, target_id, label})
```
Handler: {:append_label_change, target_id, label} →
  - {sm, entry} = SessionManager.append_label_change(sm, target_id, label)
  - write entry to file (same pattern as existing append_entry/3)
  - {:reply, :ok, updated_state}

## Coder (apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder.ex)

### get_tree/1
```elixir
@spec get_tree(pid()) :: [OctoPi.Coder.Session.TreeNode.t()]
def get_tree(server), do: GenServer.call(server, :get_tree)
```
Handler in Loop GenServer: delegates to SessionStore.get_tree(session_store_pid).

### set_label/3
```elixir
@spec set_label(pid(), String.t(), String.t() | nil) :: :ok
def set_label(server, target_id, label),
  do: GenServer.call(server, {:set_label, target_id, label})
```
Handler in Loop GenServer: delegates to SessionStore.append_label_change/3.

## Notes
- Read the existing :get_entries handler in Loop for the delegation pattern to follow.
- set_label/3 name chosen to match the Elixir convention (vs upstream appendLabelChange);
  the wire name can be {:set_label, target_id, label}.

## Files
- apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_store.ex
- apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder.ex
- The Loop GenServer (find via grep for :get_entries handler)

## Tests
Integration: start a SessionStore with a seeded session, call get_tree, confirm label
fields are nil. Call append_label_change, call get_tree again, confirm label appears.

## Verification
iex> Coder.get_tree(session_pid)  # returns [%TreeNode{...}]
iex> Coder.set_label(session_pid, entry_id, "my-label")
iex> Coder.get_tree(session_pid)  # label field now set
title: SessionStore + Coder: get_tree/1 and set_label/3 delegation
